name: @mymehq/integration-google-drive
description: Inbound-only Google Drive connector (Drive v3 API). Schedule trigger seeds + incrementally syncs via files.list + changes.list with a persisted pageToken cursor; webhook trigger receives changes.watch push notifications and triggers a re-sync. Reuses the Google OAuth provider credential established for the google.* family via credential_ref. Blob handling deferred (substrate gap — ConnectionClient.uploadBlob not yet exposed). Outbound writes deferred to a follow-on ticket.
